delta_review.summary: The remediation adds targeted transaction-failure recovery coverage, unifies first-processing request identity, and enforces a finite shutdown deadline.
delta_review.evidence: All 14 delta files, all previous finding paths, and the complete affected base-to-head call paths were inspected.

finding_revalidation.evidence: The new test proves Idea, statement, and idempotency rollback, but creates no clarification question and raises before audit insertion, so its question and audit zero-count assertions are non-discriminating.
All business routes use Fastify request.id for first processing; contract and acceptance tests prove initial log/response/audit correlation and preserved original-ID replay semantics.
The shutdown helper races close work against a real deadline, force-closes remaining connections, and the held-request child regression exits within the deterministic deadline margin.

summary: This re-review closes the request-identity and finite-shutdown findings. Approval renewal is withheld on preserved finding PRR-001 only.

findings.title: Rollback regression does not prove every claimed mutation rolls back
findings.observation: The fixture has no clarification question, so a zero question count is vacuous. The BEFORE INSERT audit trigger raises before any audit row exists, so a zero audit count does not prove rollback of a successful audit mutation. verification.md nevertheless claims Idea, statements, questions, audit, and idempotency state were all demonstrated to roll back.
findings.trigger: A future change moves clarification-question or audit persistence outside the service-owned transaction while this regression continues to create no question and fail before audit insertion.
findings.impact: The repository can claim complete LP1-REQ-021/LP1-AC-008 atomicity while regressions in two explicitly claimed write categories remain undetected.

evidence.description: createBody declares clarificationQuestions as an empty array.
The injected trigger raises BEFORE INSERT on audit_events, before the target audit row can exist.
The zero-count assertions for clarification_questions and audit_events are therefore true without rollback of either mutation.
The verification record claims the regression demonstrates rollback of questions and audit state in addition to the earlier writes.

findings.remediation: Make the fixture create at least one clarification question and inject the infrastructure failure after a successful audit insert but before commit, such as on the terminal idempotency-status update. Assert all created business, question, audit, and idempotency rows are absent and that the same key succeeds after recovery.
findings.verification: The regression fails if either question or audit writes escape the transaction, passes on the remediation head, and the full integration and acceptance suites pass.

findings.observation: Business routes now use the Fastify request-scoped ID, while terminal idempotent replay returns the documented original first-processing ID.
findings.trigger: Initial business reads or writes and a later terminal replay.
findings.impact: Operators can correlate initial response and audit IDs with request logs without breaking replay identity semantics.

evidence.description: Contract coverage compares the on-request ID, logger serializer ID, and response ID.

findings.title: Shutdown grace now bounds process termination
findings.observation: Shutdown now races application and pool closure against a real deadline, force-closes remaining work, and exits with a defined failure outcome on expiry.
findings.trigger: SIGTERM or SIGINT arrives while a request and close hook remain unsettled.
findings.impact: Restart and deployment no longer rely solely on an external supervisor to terminate the process after grace expiry.

evidence.description: The helper races graceful work against a deadline and force-closes connections on expiry.
A child holds an in-flight request and non-settling hook, then exits with code 1 inside the deterministic deadline margin after SIGTERM.

findings.verification: Shutdown unit tests and the complete verify run pass.

required_actions.action: Make the post-mutation rollback regression discriminating for clarification-question and successful audit writes, then align verification.md with the demonstrated evidence.
Unify first-processing request identity across logs, initial responses, command context, and audit while preserving replay identity semantics.
Enforce a finite shutdown deadline and cover it with a held-request child process.
